tha-ap73:1.1: Sakacittiyavaggo sattamo. [VIII. NĀGASAMALAVAGGO.] [71. Nāgasamāla.] Apāṭaliṃ ahaṃ pupphaṃ ujjhitaṃ sumahāpathe / thūpamhi abhiropesiṃ Sikhino lokabandhuno. // //
tha-ap73:2.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi thūpapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap73:3.1: Ito pannarase kappe Bhūmiyo nāma khattiyo / sattaratanasampanno cakkavatti mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap73:4.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap73:5.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Nāgasamālo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
